Apple___Apple_scab.solution: Apply fungicides such as Captan or Mancozeb during early growth stages. Remove and destroy infected leaves and fruits to reduce spread. Ensure proper spacing for airflow and avoid overhead irrigation. Repeat spray at regular intervals during wet conditions.
Apple___Apple_scab.prevention: Plant resistant apple varieties and maintain orchard hygiene. Prune trees regularly to improve air circulation. Avoid excess nitrogen fertilization. Monitor plants frequently for early detection.
Apple___Apple_scab.organic: Use neem oil or sulfur sprays weekly. Apply baking soda solution (1 tsp per liter water) to affected leaves. Remove infected plant parts and keep area clean.

Apple___Black_rot.solution: Prune and remove infected branches and fruits immediately. Apply fungicides like Thiophanate-methyl. Maintain proper sanitation in orchard. Ensure good drainage and avoid water stagnation.
Apple___Black_rot.prevention: Remove fallen debris and mummified fruits. Prune regularly to improve sunlight exposure. Avoid injuries to bark and fruits. Maintain balanced fertilization.
Apple___Black_rot.organic: Use neem oil sprays regularly. Apply compost tea to improve plant immunity. Remove infected parts manually.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.solution: Apply fungicides such as Myclobutanil during early infection stages. Remove nearby cedar trees if possible. Prune infected leaves and maintain plant hygiene.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.prevention: Avoid planting apple near cedar trees. Use resistant apple varieties. Monitor during spring season closely.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.organic: Use sulfur-based sprays. Apply neem oil weekly. Remove infected leaves early.
